about_short_description.short_description: Netmaker is a modern virtual platform providing networking solution that runs on wireguard.

product.name: Netmaker Mesh VPN
product.description: A virtual networking solution that allows devices to connect directly to each other, forming a decentralized network without a central server.

product.name: Netclient
product.description: A software agent that configures WireGuard and routing rules on devices to establish secure connections within the mesh network.

product.name: Managed Endpoints
product.description: Dedicated routing nodes for VPN traffic, enabling relay, failover, remote access, and internet traffic routing without deploying additional devices.

product.name: Internet Gateway
product.description: A feature that simplifies traditional VPN setups by creating traffic forwarders using relays and providing direct connections between devices.

product.name: IoT Gateway
product.description: A solution for integrating IoT devices into a secure, WireGuard-based VPN, supporting devices like ESP32 for private connections over public networks.
